citations.title: Magda Chambriard

sentences.text: Magda Maria de Regina Chambriard, born in Rio de Janeiro in 1957, holds a degree in civil engineering from the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (1979) and a master's degree in chemical engineering from COPPE/UFRJ (1989), with specializations in reservoir engineering and formation evaluation and in oil and gas production at what is now Universidade Petrobras.

sentences.quote: Between 2012 and 2016 she was the first female director-general of the National Agency of Petroleum, Natural Gas and Biofuels (ANP)
sentences.text: She began her career at Petrobras in 1980, working throughout in the production area, and joined the oil regulator ANP in 2002 as a board advisor, working mainly in exploration and production; between 2012 and 2016 she was the first woman to serve as director-general of the ANP.
She has been a member of the board of directors and chief executive officer of Petroleo Brasileiro SA since May 24, 2024, succeeding Jean Paul Prates after his early termination.

sentences.quote: She is currently, in addition to being a member of the Board of Directors and CEO of Petrobras, Chair of the Board of Directors of IBP and Chair of the Board of Directors of BRASKEM S.A.
sentences.text: She also chairs the boards of IBP and of Braskem SA.
